reason: The remediation only edits a PAM password quality configuration file to set maxclassrepeat. This is a standard STIG hardening change that does not affect system boot, networking, or critical services, and it will not lock out existing users; it only tightens password composition rules.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Potential for legitimate passwords to be rejected if they contain too many consecutive characters from the same class; Possible user confusion if the new policy is stricter than current practice
